title: How We Replaced Our Pricing System While It Was Running
summary: In mid-2023, if you asked, "Why does this shift have this price?" the answer lived in at least four places. Eleven months later, one service priced every shift in real time, the moment a worker requested it. We never flipped a switch. We turned a dial.
